title: Upcoming Events In First Quarter 2020
html:
The first month of 2020 is almost gone and besides very high activity in the new year on development side (e.g., release of 5.3.2 and 5.2.6, support for structured json logging, two new modules mqtt and secsipid (STIR/SHAKEN), …), Kamailio developers and community members are preparing to attend many events around the world in the first quarter, among them:

  • Fosdem, February 1-2, 2020, in Brussels, Belgium
  • Open SourceWorld and ITExpo East, February 11-12, in Ft. Lauderdale, FL, USA
  • Mobile World Congress, February 24-27, 2020, in Barcelona, Spain
  • Call Center World, March 2-5, in Berlin, Germany
  • SimCon3, March 5-6, 2020 in Bristol, UK
  • Kamailio Advanced Training, March 9-11, 2020, in Berlin, Germany
  • IETF 107, March 21-27, 2020, in Vancouver, Canada
  • Kamailio World Conference, April 27-29, 2020, in Berlin, Germany

Should you be aware of other events where you plan to participate and meet Kamailio folks, let us know via sr-users mailing list and we will add to this list.

Looking forward to meeting many enthusiastic Kamailians along 2020!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
